json_numbers.src:
unsafe base.
S = use "std/string".
L = use "std/list".
O = use "std/os".
J = use "std/json".
show s = case J.parse s of Ok v -> "Ok({J.render v})" | Err e -> "Err({e})".
q = chr 34.
main =
  _ = print "{show "1e400"} {show "-0"} {show "9223372036854775808"} {show "4611686018427387904"} {show "1.5e308"} {show "-1e400"}";
  _ = print "{show "[1,]"} {show (strcat (strcat (chr 123) q) (strcat "a" (strcat q (strcat ":1," (strcat q (strcat "a" (strcat q (strcat ":2" (chr 125)))))))))} {show "1 2"} {show ""} {show "   "}";
  _ = print "{show (strcat q (strcat (chr 0) q))} {show (strcat q (strcat (chr 1) q))} {show (strcat q (strcat (chr 255) q))} {show "[1e-400]"} {show "0.1e"} {show "00"} {show "-"}";
  print "done".
json_numbers.note: json numbers, duplicate keys, control and invalid bytes

list_big.src:
unsafe base.
S = use "std/string".
L = use "std/list".
O = use "std/os".
J = use "std/json".
build : Int -> List Int -> List Int .
build 0 acc = acc.
build n acc = build (n - 1) (n :: acc).
main = xs = build 5000000 Nil; print "len={L.length xs}".
